overview.text:
Gokarna, on the Konkan coast of Uttara Kannada, is both a pilgrim town and a beach escape, slower and quieter than Goa to the north. The Mahabaleshwar Temple, believed to date to the 4th century, holds the Atmalinga of Shiva that legend says Ganesha tricked Ravana into setting down here. It is one of Karnataka's seven Mukti Kshetras, and pilgrims first visit the Maha Ganapati Temple and bathe in Kotiteertha or the sea.

South of town, five beaches are linked by a 2–4 hour cliff-top trek: Gokarna Main, palm-fringed Kudle, Om Beach with its water sports, and Half Moon and Paradise, reached only on foot or by boat. Yoga, surfing and diving trips to Netrani Island fill longer stays, and Mirjan Fort, the Yana rocks and Murudeshwar make good day trips. Come October–March, when the seas are calm.

plan.overview: Temple first, beaches second, day trip third — a classic Gokarna pattern.
plan.transport: Walk and boats between beaches; a taxi for day trips.
plan.season: October to March, when seas are calm; monsoon closes the beaches for swimming.

days.title: Day 1: Temple and town
days.summary: Early darshan at the Mahabaleshwar Temple (from 6 am), then Kudle Beach; sunset on Main Beach.
days.travel: Overnight bus from Bengaluru, or train to Gokarna Road, Ankola or Kumta.
days.meals: Breakfast in the town bazaar; dinner at a Kudle cafe.
days.distance: Kudle Beach is a 10-minute walk south of town
days.driveTime: None — the temple and Kudle Beach are on foot

days.title: Day 2: Beach trek
days.summary: Om Beach in the morning, then trek over the headlands to Half Moon and Paradise; return by boat.

stops.name: Beach trek to Paradise
stops.note: Sturdy shoes and water; return by boat if tired.

days.meals: Carry water and snacks; lunch at an Om Beach shack.
days.distance: Om Beach about 6 km from town
days.driveTime: On foot along the beach trail, or a short auto ride to Om Beach

days.title: Day 3: Mirjan Fort and Murudeshwar
days.summary: Mirjan Fort in the morning, then Murudeshwar's Shiva statue and gopura.
days.distance: Mirjan Fort about 21–22 km north on NH 66; Murudeshwar about 76 km south of Gokarna

faqs.q: How long is the beach trek?
faqs.a: About 2–4 hours from Kudle to Paradise.

faqs.q: Can I swim at Main Beach?
faqs.a: No: currents are strong. Om Beach has calmer water.
